# Fitness Test Lab

> > Evidence-based home fitness equipment reviews and workout guidance by Mario Guerra, specializing in kettlebells, specialty barbells, bumper plates, and home gym optimization.

Fitness Test Lab provides comprehensive buying guides, equipment reviews, and training resources for home fitness enthusiasts. The site focuses on practical, tested recommendations for brands like Bells of Steel, Rep Fitness, Rogue, and Vulcan Strength, with particular expertise in kettlebell training and specialty barbell equipment.

## Key Topics

- Kettlebells (cast iron vs competition)
- Home gym equipment
- Specialty barbells (Swiss bar, trap bar)
- Olympic bumper plates
- Evidence-based fitness
- Bells of Steel
- Rep Fitness
- Rogue Fitness
- CrossFit training
- Weight vests
- Kettlebell sizing and brands
- HIIT workouts
- DIY fitness equipment
- Competition kettlebells

- [The Complete Kettlebell Buyers Guide](https://fitnesstestlab.com/blog/kettlebell-buyers-guide): Complete kettlebell buying guide: cast iron vs competition, sizing, brands
